name: artifacts.thefocus.ai
description: CLI-first Artifact publishing service for TheFocus.AI

scripts.lint: prettier --check package.json tsconfig.json vitest.config.ts vercel.json 'src/**/*.ts' 'api/**/*.ts' 'tests/**/*.ts' README.md 'docs/**/*.md' 'public/**/*.html' && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test:storage:live: node -e "for (const name of ['DATABASE_URL','BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN']) if (!process.env[name]) { console.error(name + ' is required for live storage tests'); process.exit(1) }" && vitest run tests/storage-live.test.ts --reporter verbose
scripts.test:storage:live:db: node -e "if (!process.env.DATABASE_URL) { console.error('DATABASE_URL is required for live database storage tests'); process.exit(1) }" && vitest run tests/storage-live.test.ts --reporter verbose -t 'live Neon/Postgres'
scripts.test:storage:live:blob: node -e "if (!process.env.BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN) { console.error('BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN is required for live Blob storage tests'); process.exit(1) }" && vitest run tests/storage-live.test.ts --reporter verbose -t 'live Vercel Blob'
